name: setfsuid32
description: setfsuid32 sets the filesystem user ID for a process, which is used for permissions checking when accessing filesystem objects. It allows changing the ID for file access without altering the effective user ID, primarily for specific use cases like NFS servers.

parameters.name: fsuid
parameters.description: The new filesystem user ID to set for the process.

return_value.success: Returns the previous filesystem user ID of the caller
return_value.failure: Also returns the previous filesystem user ID; no distinction from success

errors.description: The argument cannot be passed to the kernel without truncation due to kernel limitations

bugs: No error indications of any kind are returned to the caller, making it impossible to directly determine if the call succeeded or failed; the caller must use additional calls to check.
